derived_placements.method: Slingshot lamps: the bulb meshes Bulb_Prim_029 (right) and Bulb_Prim_028 (left) that the table's l66 and l82 handlers light under each slingshot plastic. Their world-space mesh-bound centres from `vpxtool export obj --units vpu` (OBJ SHA-256 1724f7a309a34180828566dd50361ea44e09b7149016391f2e78329031007205) equal their stored primitive positions to six decimal places. The Light objects l66 and l82 are invisible placeholders in a row along the bottom edge, with l1, l68, l84, l98, l100 and l114, and are not positions.
Thumper-bumper lamps: the centres of the bumper objects Bumper2 (right) and Bumper1 (left), the bumpers the l98 and l114 handlers light. The lamp sits inside the bumper body.

Chamber lamp pairs: each address drives two bulbs, one either side of the Queen's Chamber lane; the placements are the two Light objects l<n> and l<n>a whose bulb meshes Bulb_Prim_<n> and Bulb_Prim_<n>a the same handler lights. The schematic prints (2) against each of these four circuits and against no other auxiliary circuit.

10 point rebound, five contacts: the table models each side triangle's two rubber faces as one chevron-shaped wall (Phys_Sensor_34 left, Phys_Sensor_34a right) and the upper-right rebound as a third (Phys_Sensor_34b). Each chevron is split at its apex, along the line from the inner apex point to the midpoint of the two outer apex points, and each face's contact is the area centroid of its arm; the upper-right contact is the area centroid of its wall. Figure V draws two 34 contacts on each triangle and one at the upper right.
Slingshot coils: the drag-point centroids of the LeftSlingshot and RightSlingshot walls; switches 38 and 37 share them, because the slingshot switch is the wall itself.

Drop-target coils, unchanged from the earlier validated pass: each individual drop coil of the right four-bank at its target's drop-target primitive, and each bank reset (1 ORBS, 8 in-line, 9 right four) at the middle of its bank's four targets. Each lies within 0.001 of the corresponding primitive positions or their mean, which this report checks.

Kicker and magnet coils at the table's own objects for them: the outhole kicker at Drain (switch 8 shares it), the ball kick at BallRelease, the ball release at SubBallRelease, and the magnet at RMagTrig.

excluded_object_classes: Light objects parked in a row along the bottom edge (l1, l66, l68, l82, l84, l98, l100, l114), which are invisible placeholders for addresses the table lights through other objects or not at all
l68a, l84a and l100a, playfield star inserts the table drives from the bare matrix positions 68, 84 and 100, which the AS-2518-43 cannot light
render doubles stacked on a placed object: l<n>a beside each main-board l<n>, l<n>mid and l<n>top beside each chamber bulb, and the sw<n>p, sw<n>a and sw<n>o primitives on each target
bumperbiglight and bumpersmalllight helpers, whose timer_interval values are not lamp bindings, and the cabinet UndercabLight
LEDnnn objects, which are the seven-segment display digits rendered as lights
